outcome: Postoperative blood loss in bladder lavage fluid
cohort: 54 patients with Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH) undergoing trans-vesical prostatectomy.
finding: There was no difference between groups in hemoglobin, hematocrit, IPSS, hospital stay, or packed cells received, but postoperative blood loss in bladder lavage fluid was significantly lower in the surgicel group.
